title: The knowledge the roles read: one tool for the closest business examples, the examples in the decomposer's, router's and critic's evidence behind a measured switch
request: Phase 8: find_examples for the roles, the closest examples' pitfalls in the critic's and router's evidence, retrieval questions v2; an arm of the journeys measured on dev, then one fresh sealed set; served only if better.
plan: Have an independent writer reword the ten practice questions, seeing nothing else, and measure the search on them.
Add find_examples for the intern and /mcp, model-visible examples only.
Give the decomposer, the router and the critic the closest examples' lines only when the host gives them; the host gives them only behind a switch and a passed sealed arm, or when a measurement asks.
Read the gateway's recorded prompts for any private example.
Measure the roles with and without examples on the dev programme people, live and capped; the sealed run comes with 30.6's fresh set.

decisions.decision: The decomposer reads the examples too, not only the router and the critic.
decisions.why: The roles' misses on the programme journeys are parts the map leaves out; only the decomposer draws parts.

decisions.decision: The examples arm's gate was fixed before it ran: more journeys right than the roles arm without examples and at least as many as the rules, on a sealed set run once.
decisions.why: Served only if better, as the plan says, judged on people no one tuned on.

decisions.decision: The independent paraphrases are an evaluation set, never indexed and never tuned on.
decisions.why: 16 of 30 is the honest weak spot; tuning the search on them would make the number meaningless.

decisions.decision: With dev saying the examples do not help, the switch stays off; the sealed arm is run with 30.6's fresh set for the record.
decisions.why: A dev loss is a reason not to serve, not a reason to skip the measurement the plan asks for.

change: dclab_rnd.tools.find_examples (project scope); dclab_rnd.business_examples (for_role, paraphrase_recall, switched_on, serve; the manifest's practice measurements); dclab_core.mapping.draw, solutions.route_with and review.critique take examples; their prompts; dclab_rnd.draft.map.examples_for; the engine's critic examples; programme journeys --examples and examples_passed; dclab-core 0.95.0.

findings.defect: The search finds few practice questions in other words.
findings.scenario: An independent writer's thirty versions: 16 found in the first three (other industry 5 of 10, plain words 4 of 10, a short query 7 of 10), against 10 of 10 in the author's own.
findings.cause: A keyword search over the examples' own vocabulary.
findings.fix: Measured and kept in the manifest; not tuned on. A better search is open.

findings.defect: The examples did not help the roles on dev.
findings.scenario: Programme dev people: roles 3 of 6 (JPR-008), roles with examples 2 of 6 (JPR-009); every miss in both the review-budget part never drawn.
findings.cause: The roles' own failure to draw the review part; the examples do not change it.
findings.fix: The switch stays off; the review part's loss goes to 30.6.

findings.defect: 30.7's open check: nothing read the gateway's recorded prompts for a private example.
findings.scenario: With examples on, the decomposer's prompt could have carried the owner's solution.
findings.cause: No role read examples until this package.
findings.fix: A test reads the prompts the gateway sent with examples on and finds no rules_only example's id or title.

findings.defect: The capture test's fake database URL read as a committed password.
findings.scenario: The gate's secret scan flagged tests/test_run_capture.py.
findings.cause: A literal user:password URL in a fixture.
findings.fix: The URL is built from parts.

measurements.name: the example search on an independent writer's wording
measurements.result: 16 of 30 found in the first three (5 of 10, 4 of 10, 7 of 10 by kind), against 10 of 10 in the author's own words

measurements.name: the roles with and without examples on the programme dev people (live)
measurements.gate: more journeys right with examples than without, and at least as many as the rules, before a sealed run decides
measurements.result: rules 6 of 6; roles 3 of 6 (EUR 0.249); roles with examples 2 of 6 (EUR 0.3137)
limits: The roles' own misses (the review part) dominate both arms.

outcome: DCLab's roles can read the closest business examples, but do not until a sealed arm shows they do better; on dev they did not, and the switch stays off.
lessons: Measure what a role misses before giving it more to read: the examples could not supply a part the role never draws.
A weak search measured honestly is worth more than a strong one measured on its author's words.
risks: The Home agent does not have find_examples yet; it comes after an arm passes.
The search's weakness on plain words limits what any role could read.
